description: High Ratchet Torque: The BOSCH socket set features a powerful ratchet capable of delivering a torque of 74-93 Nm, which exceeds the DIN standard by up to 50%. This makes it perfect for handling a variety of DIY tasks, ensuring you have the strength needed to fasten or loosen even the toughest bolts or nuts with minimal effort. Ergonomic Soft Grip Handle: The ratchet is equipped with a carefully designed ergonomic handle, featuring a soft grip that enhances both comfort and control during prolonged use. This reduces hand strain, making it ideal for extended projects where repetitive motions are necessary. Magnetic Bits Holder for Safe Use: A standout feature of this set is its magnetic bits holder, which securely holds bits in place during use. This ensures that bits don’t fall out or get misplaced during work, providing a safer and more efficient experience. The magnetic holder also makes it easier to change bits quickly, saving you time on any project. Portable and Easy to Store: The set comes with a sturdy, compact storage case that makes it convenient to carry around. Whether you’re moving between rooms during a project or traveling with your tools, the case keeps everything neatly organized and easy to transport. The case also ensures that each piece is protected from damage when not in use. Versatile Set for Multiple DIY Tasks: This 34-piece socket set is designed to cover a wide range of DIY tasks. Whether you're assembling furniture, repairing appliances, or working on automotive projects, the set includes everything you need. The combination of ratchet, sockets, adapters, and bits offers versatility for tackling various fastening and loosening jobs around the house or garage. Durable and Long-Lasting Construction: Made from a blend of durable materials, including high-strength metal, plastic, and rubber, the tools in this set are built to last. The high-quality construction ensures that the tools can withstand frequent use in challenging conditions, offering long-term reliability for all your DIY projects. Wide Range of Sockets and Adapters: With 10 different socket sizes and 4 adapters included, this set gives you the flexibility to work with various fastener types and sizes. The securely fitting adapters and sockets ensure a stable connection between the tool and the fastener, reducing the risk of slipping or rounding off the edges of bolts and nuts. Ideal for Tight or Hard-to-Reach Areas: The compact and precise design of the ratchet and screwdriver in this set allows for easy access to tight spaces or hard-to-reach areas. This feature is particularly useful when working on tasks that require precision, such as repairing small appliances or working in confined spaces where larger tools won’t fit.
